title: LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
body:
LAHOO LAHOO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
UTHOU SAANI E HYDER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
1. NABI KE PYAAR E NAWASE PE ZULM HAI KAISA
PADA HAI RETH PE PAMAAL BEKAFAN TANHA
RULA RAHA HAI YEH MANZER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. JUDA KIYA PASE GARDAN SE JO SAR E SARWAR
CHADAYA NAIZE PE SARWAR KA KHOO BHARA WO SAR
ZAMEEN PE DEKHO HAI BESAR HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. JHULASTI RETH JO ZAQMOU ME CHUPTI JAATI HAI
YEH DEKH FATIMA ZEHRA BHI ROTI JAATI HAI
YEH KAISE DEKHEGI MADAR HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
4. SOOMO SE ROUDH NE ATE HAI LASHA E SHABBIR
SADA YEH DETI THI MAQTAL ME ZAINAB E DILGEER
BACHALO AAKE DILAWAR HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SUKOON KAISE MILEGA WOH AB YATEEMA KO
UDHAR TAMACHE LAGATE HAI JO SAKINA KO
IDHAR TADAPTA HAI ROOKER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
6. KAHAAN JOH SHUMR NE PAMAAL HOUNGE SUB LASHE
SAB APNE APNOU KE LASHE UTHAYE MAIDAN SE
THA SIRF EK ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
7. BALA KE DHAST MEI SHADAAB GHAR JOH UJDA HAI
KAYI ZAMANE SE SARWAR KA GHAM YEH TAZAA HAI
HAI DAFN SEENO KE ANDER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<MINI>>
LAAHO LAAHO HAI ZAMEEN PER HUSSAIN KA LASHA
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ-REHAN RAZVI SHADAAB
